metric.piece_field_distance: Hamming distance over the first 12 coordinates
metric.total_structural_distance: piece-field distance plus placard Hamming distance
metric.minimum_search: ascending exact structural distance before selection
metric.candidate_set_digest_encoding: ascending ordered pairs as big-endian uint16(base_scene_index), uint16(intervention_scene_index)
metric.selection_tiebreak_encoding: dependency digests, family, and the same big-endian ordered scene-index pair
